summary: At the final bare-handed claw attack, C reports that the silver ring sears the manes and waits for the message pager. JavaScript skips the missing weapon.c:silver_sears call, omits that message, and continues the turn; the manes die and the final screen and cursor diverge.

source.branch: When a polymorphed hero's landed attack earns silver-ring damage and verbose messages are enabled, hmonas calls silver_sears with the worn-ring mask. The helper names the left or right ring, uses plural wording when both ring slots qualify, and emits the searing message.
callers: uhitm.c:do_attack() selects hmonas() for Upolyd at lines 565-568; hmonas() calls silver_sears() in its claw/touch and hug branches at lines 5662, 5726, 5744, and 5756.
hack.c:domove_core() calls do_attack(); the JavaScript production route is hack.js:domove_core() -> uhitm.js:do_attack() -> hmonas().
dependencies: weapon.c:special_dmgval() supplies the silverhit ring mask and is already implemented in js/weapon.js.
The hmonas attack and damage branches are already implemented in js/uhitm.js; four corresponding silver_sears call sites still use note_unported().
do_name.c:mon_nam(), objnam.c:vtense(), and the existing message operation provide the helper's naming, agreement, and output behavior.
